entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The nation after which Urza named the soldiers.

entities.name: Gull

entities.description: Owner of the tropical island where Yotian soldiers lived.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war during which Urza made the Yotian soldiers.

events.summary: After the Fall of Kroog, Urza creates the Yotian soldiers as a home guard and stations them in his tower, Argive and Korlis.
events.quote: They were created to serve as a home guard to protect allied cities while their army was away.

events.summary: Jodah faces an old Yotian soldier in his Conclave of Mages initiation test and depowers it.
events.quote: he managed to depower it after a protracted struggle

events.summary: When K'rrik's Phyrexian forces invade the Tolarian Academy, Barrin activates the Yotian soldiers as defenses.
events.quote: Barrin activated them as part of the academy's defenses

events.summary: Gull discovers a tribe of self-modified, ant-like Yotian soldiers on Towser's island.
events.quote: Gull discovered that a tribe of Yotian soldiers lived on Towser 's tropical island

events.summary: Allav Hask faces a battalion of refurbished Yotians for a month.
events.quote: Allav Hask faced an entire battalion of refurbished Yotians for a month

relations.quote: artifact creatures created for defense by Urza
